name: mcpaudit
oneLiner: Lints any MCP server for spec conformance and safety, locally, with zero dependencies.

metrics.label: checks, each with documented false-positive modes
runtime dependencies, enforced by a test
official reference servers audited, raw JSON committed

headline.claim: Every official MCP reference server still speaks a protocol revision the current spec replaced, so every check had to become era-aware before the tool could report anything credible.

honest: It reads what a server says about itself and applies heuristics; it does not execute tools, analyse source, or prove anything, and a clean report only means nothing common was found. Schema validation is structural rather than full JSON Schema 2020-12, only tools are inspected (not resources or prompts), and the modern-protocol lane has never met a real modern server because none exists yet.

built.audit: Research found no tool combining conformance and safety in one local CLI, and no shipping MCP server implementing the current 2026-07-28 stateless protocol.
repaired: The packed CLI produced no output at all under npx, because the entry-point guard compared against a symlinked bin path; every unit test passed throughout.
A determinism check never fired because the broken fixture's tool names were a palindrome, so reversing their order was a no-op.
S6 scanned raw wire bytes where an ESC always arrives JSON-escaped, so it could never match; it now scans decoded text.

Four false positives at error severity on real reference servers: 'clearly' matched the destructive verb 'clear' for lack of a trailing word boundary. Caught by hand-review before publication; regression tests now pin the exact strings.
The drift detector hashed uncanonicalised JSON, so a server that merely reordered its keys would have looked like a rug pull on every re-audit.
The weekly spec-drift job was circular, reading the protocol version out of the versioned file that always matches itself.
measured: Four official reference servers audited with raw --json committed: all speak 2025-11-25, nine findings total, zero at error severity.
Era-awareness reduced those four audits from a wall of false failures to two findings each, by skipping inapplicable checks with a stated reason.
npm pack installed into a clean directory resolves to a single package with no transitive dependencies.

decisions.what: Zero runtime dependencies over commander, zod and undici
decisions.why: A security tool's own supply chain is part of its pitch; the official conformance suite ships with a substantial dependency tree. The cost, stated openly, is structural rather than full JSON Schema validation.

decisions.what: Era-aware checks over a flat conformance suite
decisions.why: No shipping server implements 2026-07-28, so firing modern checks at legacy servers would produce a wall of false positives and destroy credibility on contact. Inapplicable checks are skipped with a reason, never failed.
Overclaiming security invites public dismantling by people who do this professionally. Every check documents how it misfires, and RULES.md is generated from that metadata so it cannot drift.
